steps.action: Open the model picker.
Pick each model from each provider group in turn.
Send a message each time, with a file attached.
acceptanceCriteria: Every model replies without error
The attached file is accepted by every model

tests.goal: My default model persists across refresh and multiple sessions

steps.action: Open the app and start a chat with a model (Model A).
Switch to another chat with a different model and ask a query.
Reload the original chat.
acceptanceCriteria: Model A is still active

steps.action: Start a new chat.
acceptanceCriteria: Model A is still the default model

steps.action: Open model selector and pin a model.
acceptanceCriteria: The pinned model appears above your list of historic chats, and acts as a shortcut to continue your latest chat (or start a new chat if you weren't actively chatting) with your chosen model

steps.action: Unpin the model.
acceptanceCriteria: It disappears

tests.goal: Tags zero-cost models as "Free" in the model selector and suggests them in the out-of-balance error

steps.action: Open the model selector.
acceptanceCriteria: GPT 6 Luna shows a green "Free" pill
Terra, Sol and the other paid models do not

steps.action: Send a message on Luna.
acceptanceCriteria: The balance gauge (bottom-left) does not drop

steps.action: Only if your balance is exhausted, send a message on a paid model.
acceptanceCriteria: The error says "You can still keep chatting using our free models: GPT 6 Luna."

tests.goal: Replaces old Anthropic models with 5.5 versions and aligns provider labels

steps.action: Open the model selector.
acceptanceCriteria: Old Anthropic models are gone
Anthropic Global and Anthropic Australia each list Haiku, Sonnet and Opus 5.5

steps.action: Open Agent Builder and view the provider names and model list.
acceptanceCriteria: Providers read "OpenAI Global", "Anthropic Global" and "Anthropic Australia"
The model lists match the main dropdown

steps.action: Open the model selector for Luna and Sol, then in both General Chat and Agent Builder, send a normal chat message.
acceptanceCriteria: GPT 6 Luna and GPT 6.1 Sol are available
Normal chat works

steps.action: Use file search with each model.
acceptanceCriteria: File search works

steps.action: Use web search with each model.
acceptanceCriteria: Web search works

steps.action: Use memory with every model, including Anthropic AU models.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory works for all models

steps.action: Check the conversation title after the first reply, for all models including Anthropic AU.
acceptanceCriteria: A title is auto-generated

steps.action: Open the model selector.
acceptanceCriteria: No Gemini 2.5 models are listed

steps.action: Open the Agent Builder model list.
acceptanceCriteria: No Gemini 2.5 models are listed

steps.action: Chat with the remaining Gemini models.
acceptanceCriteria: Other Gemini models still work

steps.action: Look at the bottom-left balance gauge.
acceptanceCriteria: It shows the current balance (e.g. $15/15)

acceptanceCriteria: The gauge decreases
